svg.title: Exhibit 02 — Pinger
svg.desc: Three services that continuously probe URLs and record latency, response code and size, deployed to a local multi-node kind cluster with two pinger versions running side by side. Illustrated with an animated schematic. Repository: github.com/Anup-Narkhede/Pinger_App_K8S.
svg.text: Is it up? How fast? Ask again, forever.
frontend · pinger v1 + v2 · details on a 3-worker kind cluster
